name: DFX Finance Curve flash() reentrancy
summary: Curve.flash() was the only state-changing entry point without the contract's nonReentrant guard, so the attacker re-entered deposit() inside flashCallback and had the flash-loaned XIDR/USDC counted both as flash repayment and as a new LP deposit, then withdrew the underlying.
notes: The vulnerable unguarded flash function is part of the Curve's immutable direct runtime, created by this transaction.
Approximate gross protocol loss reported by Numen across the DFX v2 attack.
The loss source reports an approximate $4 million protocol-wide total rather than exact per-asset quantities.
